content: GPAC's 1.0 rearchitecture unified demux/decode into a single filter-graph model: demuxers, parsers and decoders are all 'filters' connected in a session graph rather than being architecturally separate layers. MP4Box uses a 'Probe filter' to query demuxed PIDs without necessarily decoding. This is a different pattern from strict layering: GPAC composes an arbitrary filter chain per task rather than running fixed sequential passes -- shows an alternative (dataflow-graph) architecture to mediadiff's proposed strictly-layered passes.
